key_reasoning.reason: New in-process SDK compressor (sdk_compressor.py) alongside the sidecar compressor, plus factory/resolver/scope/hook changes, a new HeadroomSavings DTO on token usage, analytics handler and metric names, monitoring service, conversation persistence, workflow execution and langgraph agent wiring. Multiple subsystems and a new mode/strategy abstraction.

Closest pattern is the existing sidecar compressor; it does not cover in-process SDK risks: process-wide forced privacy env (HEADROOM_BEACON/DO_NOT_TRACK/CCR memory), lazy import with permanent disable on failure, non-interruptible synchronous SDK call in a bounded thread pool for timeouts, mixed-mode/mixed-strategy savings merging. Privacy-sensitive, plus 19 test files for terminal-path and parity edge cases.
43 files in 6 implementation commits plus a 19-file fix-up (about 62 file touches, lockfile excluded), 2274+435 insertions across src, tests, Dockerfile, docker-compose, customer config and docs.

New heavyweight headroom-ai package in pyproject/poetry.lock with Dockerfile changes and an optional-presence path (SDK may be absent), plus config/env additions (HEADROOM_SDK_ALLOW_MODEL_DOWNLOAD, offline model handling).

API (assistant and analytics routers), Service (headroom, analytics, conversation, workflow), persistence (savings stored on assistant turn/conversation models), Infrastructure (Dockerfile, docker-compose, customer-config), External (Headroom sidecar and SDK model download).
